review.method: Viewed every linked overview sheet in order and inspected native-resolution source frames 00000–00001, including the opening HUD state.

evidence.cue: Selected champion is visible at low health near a wall while multiple other champions and projectile effects are present.
Selected champion moves away from the nearby enemy and turret area.
Selected champion continues moving through jungle-side terrain.

events.uncertainty: Combat began before the clip starts; selected-player attack/ability effects are not reliably separable from simultaneous effects.

evidence.cue: Q icon changes to blue with a 5-second cooldown.
Q cooldown remains displayed while selected champion is under pressure.

events.uncertainty: HUD supports Q activation, but scene effects are crowded and target/outcome cannot be assigned.

cases.scope: Initial Q and W cooldown states.

evidence.cue: Q transitions to a fractional countdown.

cases.reason: Q and W display active cooldown values at the first frame.
cases.forbidden_claim: Do not call these initial values fresh casts.

cases.reason: Cooldown values are on the ability icons; small upper slot numerals are costs.

cases.scope: View follows the selected player across lane edge and jungle terrain; player movement is also visible.

evidence.cue: Scene includes low-health selected champion near wall and nearby opponents.
View has shifted to jungle path as selected champion retreats.

cases.forbidden_claim: Camera movement does not establish action or stationary-player status.

cases.scope: Several other champions and overlapping projectile/ability effects appear during the fight; attribution remains ambiguous.

evidence.cue: An enemy champion emits a bright projectile toward the selected champion.
Multiple champions and simultaneous effects are visible around the turret.
A distinct blue ally and red-side champions remain on screen during effects.

cases.forbidden_claim: Do not attribute overlapping effects to the selected champion without direct evidence.

cases.reason: No recall bar or attempted channel is visible.
An active multi-champion fight and selected-player movement are visible.

unknown_intervals.reason: Fight is already in progress at clip start; preceding action and onset are outside the supplied interval.
Overlapping champion effects and HUD cooldown changes obscure causal actor, target and outcomes.

notes: Source-only visual review. Prior exposure to a general League annotation task is disclosed; no current candidate recognition predictions, detector outputs, caches, other labels, or model outputs were viewed. Candidate-selection neighborhoods may have historical exposure as stated in the instructions. Overview sampling does not prove absence of rapid actions; quiet is left unresolved unless the required complete native review was performed.
